name: issue-dial
description: A pane for a GitHub repo's issues: up to three columns, one per issue in hand (one per parallel lane), each with the issues suggested to follow it.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The GitHub repos the dial turns on in, each as owner/name. Leave empty to turn it on in every GitHub repo.

planFile.title: Plan file
planFile.description: A file at the main checkout's root whose plan section lists the issues to suggest next. A missing file is fine.

planHeading.title: Plan heading
planHeading.description: The text of the ## heading that starts the plan section in the plan file.
